_comment: Default values for dashboard preferences that are persisted per-browser in localStorage. Read at init by the dashboard via GET /api/ui-defaults; used ONLY when the corresponding localStorage key is absent (first visit or after Settings → Clear Local Storage & Cookies). User toggles in the Settings popover always override and persist locally. Change a value here to shift the default for first-time visitors across all browsers served by this install. EXCEPTION: infoDialogMaxHeightPx below is not a localStorage-backed preference — see its own comment.
_infoDialogMaxHeightPx_comment: Maximum height, in pixels, of every info dialog (the circle-i help modals and the P&L breakdown modals — anything carrying the 9mm-pos-mgr-modal-help class). Past this height the dialog's body scrolls internally instead of the dialog growing until its Close button is pushed off-screen. Unlike the keys above, this is NOT persisted per-browser and is not read via /api/ui-defaults: `npm run build` bakes it into the generated public/ui-tokens.css as the --info-dialog-max-h custom property, so it applies on first paint with no inline styles and no runtime fetch. Per feedback_one_literal_per_shipped_default the literal lives here only — the CSS references the variable with no fallback value, so if the generated file is missing the dialogs simply revert to growing and the overlay scrolls.
